name: Better Stack
summary: Better Stack's free plan covers 10 monitors and 10 heartbeats checked every 3 minutes, plus a status page. Paid use costs $29 per responder a month on annual billing with unlimited SMS and phone alerts and on-call scheduling, and extra monitors come in packs of 50.

evidence.capability: http and ping checks from many locations

facts.text: Every monitor is checked from at least 4 locations by default, and an incident opens only after a check fails from at least 3 of them.
On October 21, 2026, Better Stack sent incorrect downtime notifications for single-region monitors during an internet backbone problem and advised customers to monitor from more than one region.
Data is stored in EU regions by default, with custom locations for enterprise accounts.
Sign-in with Google is included, sign-in through Azure or Okta costs $5 per user a month, and generic SAML is an enterprise feature.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 10 monitors and 10 heartbeats at 3-minute checks, 1 status page, Slack and email alerts

plans.name: Responder license
plans.notes: Billed annually; $34 on monthly billing. 10 monitors at 30-second checks, unlimited SMS and phone alerts, on-call scheduling

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Price on request. Adds generic SAML single sign-on and custom data locations

hiddenCosts: Each block of 50 extra monitors costs $21 a month on annual billing or $25 monthly.
Extra status pages cost $12 each a month on annual billing, and each extra 1,000 status page subscribers costs $40.
Historical SLA reports and CSV export need the Reporting add-on at $4 per member a month on annual billing.

security.ssoPlan: Enterprise for SAML; Google sign-in on every plan

contract.cancellation: The terms rule out refunds of amounts already paid, while the pricing page offers a 60-day money-back guarantee.
contract.dataExport: Availability summaries through the API, and CSV export with the Reporting add-on.
